skill_name: Research the topic of "Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare" and summarize the key points.
workflow: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize healthcare, from diagnosis and treatment to drug development. AI-powered technology can be used to more accurately diagnose diseases, analyze images and scans, track health data and develop new drugs that are more effective and have fewer side effects.
